notes: Fare for Medallion 447: FareToken is a self-contained ERC-20 with a zero-argument constructor, 18 decimals and burn/burnFrom. MedallionHook takes only the chain PoolManager. Its constructor validates the five declared permissions (0x10CC); beforeInitialize is disabled. Enabled callbacks accept only PoolManager. afterInitialize does not revert for PoolManager and records the first native-ETH pool as launchPool; only that pool accrues hook fees. Deployment and initialization must be atomic. DISCLOSURE: CREATOR 0x70c6C4fcaAb11151FCEDb32eaaC3431547193A0a is the requester's wallet; the intended payout is disclosed in README and NatSpec. The requester funded this fictional petition. Swaps accrue ETH-denominated ERC-6909 claims without pushing ETH. retire() is permissionless and pays CREATOR exactly 1.64 ETH once, only in the transaction that verifies medallion #447 is at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, transferring it there if necessary. It emits CreatorPaid and the pinned LastFare text and hash. A failed retirement or payout reverts atomically. The repository review records MEDALLION_NFT as the Nouns ERC-721 and #447 as held by the Nouns DAO treasury timelock at mainnet block 26098044. Retirement requires authorization from the NFT owner or prior transfer to DEAD; the documented DAO-held state requires a passed DAO proposal. Without that action the reserved ETH may remain locked indefinitely, with no alternate withdrawal. Claims above the creator entitlement can fund IMD purchases even before retirement. burnIMD() requires a permissionless keeper call; it is not executed during swaps and pays no caller reward. It uses only the fixed ETH/IMD keys: POOL4 (fee 10000, tickSpacing 60, hook 0xc6C965Bd164c483e87d0B550671798e9A3602840), or plain (fee 10000, tickSpacing 200, no hook). IMD is 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7; all purchased IMD goes to DEAD. Batches are capped at 0.05 ETH normally or 0.01 ETH in fallback, with a 0.002 ETH minimum and five blocks between burns. Callers may raise the output floor but cannot choose the batch size. Normal burns use the open POOL4 reference. Fallback requires a previous valid POOL4 reading and uses only the plain pool, with the start-of-block anchor stepping at most 200 ticks per block inside lastRef +/- 1000. pokeAnchor() can refresh or step it. The band stays fixed until POOL4 answers again: a lasting plain-pool move more than 1150 ticks below lastRef can stop fallback burns indefinitely. The one-sided guard and 96% reference-quote floor permit execution below reference within their tolerances; the plain pool is permissionless. Partial fills revert. MEDALLION_NFT, IMD and POOL4 are mainnet dependencies; their constants are retained on Sepolia, where retire(), burnIMD() and pokeAnchor() revert while swap claims accrue. The contracts expose no administrative, pause, upgrade or sweep functions. Top-level hook actions use a transient reentrancy lock on slot 1. Build settings are solc 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer 200, via_ir false, bytecode_hash none and cbor_metadata false, with vendored v4-core 1.0.2. Initial price retains the repository assumption of 10,000,000 FARE447 per ETH: initialPrice is floor(sqrt(10000000) * 2^96), encoded as a decimal sqrtPriceX96 string. Notes describe the implementation and do not set deployment policy.
